title: Simulation 3D Video Writer
text: Capture 3D simulation as video file, {Filename} sets Name of video file; {File action} sets how to manage video and {Recording interval (s)} sets the recording time interval. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Filename
params.values: Name of video file output.avi (default) | character vector | string

params.name: File action
params.values: How to manage video file Preserve (default) | Overwrite | character vector | string

params.name: Recording interval (s)
params.values: Recording time interval [0 inf] (default) | real positive 1-by-2 vector
